briefdescription.para: Initialize COM, load dbgeng DLLs, create the client, QI all interfaces, and register callbacks.

detaileddescription.para:
Performs the full COM setup sequence:
CoInitializeEx (multithreaded)
Loads dbgeng.dll from sidecarDir via Loader
Calls DebugCreate to obtain IDebugClient5
QueryInterface for IDebugControl4, IDebugSymbols3, IDebugDataSpaces4, IDebugSystemObjects
Registers OutputCallbacks and EventCallbacks
Sets source-level code level for stepping

parameterdescription.para: Directory containing extracted dbgeng sidecar DLLs.

simplesect.para: true if all COM interfaces initialized successfully.
Must be called on the main thread before any other Session method.

briefdescription.para: Launch a process for debugging.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugClient5::CreateProcess2 with the given program path. Does NOT call WaitForEvent — the caller must poll via pollEvents() to receive the initial CreateProcess and loader-breakpoint events.

parameterdescription.para: Full path to the executable to launch.

simplesect.para: true if CreateProcess2 succeeded.
The process is launched suspended until the first pollEvents call.

briefdescription.para: Attach to a running process by OS process ID.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugClient5::AttachProcess. Does NOT call WaitForEvent — the caller must poll via pollEvents() to receive the initial attach-break event.

parameterdescription.para: OS process ID of the target process.

simplesect.para: true if AttachProcess succeeded.

briefdescription.para: Resume execution after a break.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::SetExecutionStatus(DEBUG_STATUS_GO) to release the engine from a stopped state.

simplesect.para: No-op if the engine is already running.

briefdescription.para: Poll for debug events with a timeout.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::WaitForEvent with the specified timeout. Should be called repeatedly from the main loop while the target is running or stopping.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds. Pass 0 for non-blocking poll.

simplesect.para: true if an event was consumed; false on timeout with no event or on error.

briefdescription.para: Detach from the target and release all COM resources.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugClient5::EndSession with the dbgeng flag corresponding to mode, then releases all COM interface pointers. Calls CoUninitialize if this Session owns the COM apartment.

parameterdescription.para:
How to end the session:
EndMode::terminate — target is alive; kill it on detach
EndMode::detach — target is alive; leave it running after detach
EndMode::passive — target has already exited; release state only

simplesect.para: Callers must pass an explicit mode. The destructor passes EndMode::passive. Passing terminate or detach for a target that has already exited will hang; check ExecutionState before calling.

briefdescription.para: Resolve a source file path and line number to a resolution status.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSymbols3::GetOffsetByLine. Requires that symbols are loaded for the module containing the specified source file.

parameterdescription.para: Full Windows path to the source file.
One-based source line number.

simplesect.para: OffsetStatus::found — symbol found; getOffset() returns the address. OffsetStatus::notFound — no code at this line or module not loaded. OffsetStatus::engineBusy — engine transient error (E_UNEXPECTED); retry later.

briefdescription.para: Resolve a source file path and line number to a target virtual address.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSymbols3::GetOffsetByLine. Requires that symbols are loaded for the module containing the specified source file.

parameterdescription.para: Full Windows path to the source file.
One-based source line number.

simplesect.para: Resolved virtual address, or 0 when there is none.

briefdescription.para: Create a code breakpoint at the given virtual address.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::AddBreakpoint to insert an execution breakpoint. The returned engine ID is used for subsequent removeBreakpoint calls and to match incoming Breakpoint callback notifications.

parameterdescription.para: Virtual address at which to set the breakpoint.

simplesect.para: Engine-assigned breakpoint ID on success, or 0 on failure.

briefdescription.para: Create a breakpoint by source file and line.

detaileddescription.para: Cross-platform entry: Windows wraps the existing getOffsetStatus / getOffset → addBreakpoint (offset) chain; macOS delegates to SBTarget::BreakpointCreateByLocation, which lets liblldb track pending locations itself and auto-resolve as modules load (no adapter-side retry loop).

parameterdescription.para: Source file path as received from the DAP client (backslash-form on Windows, forward-slash on macOS; BreakpointManagerHandlers handles the platform branch before calling).
Requested line (1-based, matching DAP).

simplesect.para: BreakpointLocation packing (engineId, resolvedLine). engineId is 0 only when BP creation itself errored. resolvedLine is 0 when the BP has no location yet (caller treats 0 as pending — liblldb will auto-resolve).

briefdescription.para: Remove a previously created breakpoint by its engine ID.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::RemoveBreakpoint. The engine ID is no longer valid after a successful removal.

parameterdescription.para: The engine-assigned breakpoint ID returned by addBreakpoint.

simplesect.para: juce::Result::ok() on success, or juce::Result::fail(...) if the ID is not found.

briefdescription.para: Force-reload PDB symbols for a specific module.

detaileddescription.para: Executes ".reload /f <imageName>" via IDebugControl4::Execute. Used after a new module loads to ensure its symbols are available before breakpoint resolution is attempted.

parameterdescription.para: The image file name (basename or full path) as reported by the LoadModule event.

simplesect.para: juce::Result::ok() if the command executed without error.
Symbol loading may still fail silently if the PDB is not locatable.

briefdescription.para: Force-reload PDB symbols for all currently loaded modules.

detaileddescription.para: Executes ".reload /f" via IDebugControl4::Execute. Intended as a fallback when per-module reload is insufficient.

simplesect.para: juce::Result::ok() if the command executed without error.
Can be slow when many modules are loaded. Prefer loadModuleSymbols for targeted reloads after individual module-load events.

briefdescription.para: Step over one source line without entering function calls.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::SetExecutionStatus(DEBUG_STATUS_STEP_OVER). Requires source-level code level (set during initialize).

simplesect.para: The step completes asynchronously. EventCallbacks sets State::hasStepCompleted when the step is done.

briefdescription.para: Step into the next function call on the current source line.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::SetExecutionStatus(DEBUG_STATUS_STEP_INTO). Requires source-level code level (set during initialize).

simplesect.para: The step completes asynchronously. EventCallbacks sets State::hasStepCompleted when the step is done.

briefdescription.para: Step out of the current function to its call site.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugControl4::SetExecutionStatus(DEBUG_STATUS_STEP_BRANCH) to execute until the current function returns.

simplesect.para: The step completes asynchronously. EventCallbacks sets State::hasStepCompleted when the step is done.

briefdescription.para: Interrupt a running target process.

detaileddescription.para: Calls DebugBreakProcess on the target to force it into a stopped state. The resulting break is reported via EventCallbacks as a normal stop event.

parameterdescription.para: OS process ID of the target to interrupt.

briefdescription.para: Append a path to the dbgeng symbol search path.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSymbols3::AppendSymbolPath. The appended path is searched in addition to any path set at initialization time.

parameterdescription.para: Semicolon-delimited symbol path to append (e.g. "C:\\Symbols;srv*").

briefdescription.para: Append a path to the dbgeng source search path.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSymbols3::AppendSourcePath. Used to help dbgeng locate source files when resolving line information.

parameterdescription.para: Semicolon-delimited source path to append.

memberdef.name: getStackTrace

briefdescription.para: Return stack frames for the current thread as a DAP-formatted array.

detaileddescription.para: Walks the call stack up to maxFrames deep using IDebugControl4::GetStackTrace and resolves each frame to source file, line, and function name via IDebugSymbols3::GetLineByOffset and GetNameByOffset.

Each element in the returned array is a DynamicObject with fields:
id (int) — DAP frame ID (allocated by Whatdbg, not here)
name (String) — demangled function name or "??"
source (Object) — { name, path } if source info is available
line (int) — one-based source line number
column (int) — always 1 (column not resolved; 1-based per DAP convention)

parameterdescription.para: Maximum number of frames to return. Clamped to stack depth.

simplesect.para: Array of frame objects. Empty if the stack cannot be walked.
Must be called while the target is stopped.

memberdef.references: juce::Array< typename ElementType, typename TypeOfCriticalSectionToUse, int minimumAllocatedSize >::add

memberdef.name: getLocals

briefdescription.para: Return local variables for a given stack frame as a DAP-formatted array.

detaileddescription.para: Uses IDebugSymbols3::GetScopeSymbolGroup2 to obtain the symbol group for the specified frame, then iterates top-level symbols to build the variable list. Delegates value formatting to debug::prettyPrint and debug::formatSymbolValue.

Each element in the returned array is a DynamicObject with fields:
name (String) — symbol name
value (String) — formatted value string
type (String) — type name from dbgeng
variablesReference (int) — non-zero if the variable can be expanded
symbolIndex (int) — index in the symbol group (for child expansion)

parameterdescription.para: Zero-based stack frame index (0 = innermost frame).

simplesect.para: Array of variable objects. Empty if the frame has no locals or an error occurs.
Must be called while the target is stopped.

memberdef.references: juce::Array< typename ElementType, typename TypeOfCriticalSectionToUse, int minimumAllocatedSize >::add

memberdef.name: getVariableChildren

briefdescription.para: Return child variables of an expanded composite variable.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSymbolGroup2::ExpandSymbol on the symbol at symbolIndex, then iterates the newly exposed children. Used to implement DAP variable expansion (struct fields, array elements, pointer dereferences).
Each element in the returned array has the same schema as getLocals entries.

parameterdescription.para: Zero-based stack frame index containing the parent variable.
Index of the parent symbol in the frame's symbol group.

simplesect.para: Array of child variable objects. Empty if the symbol has no children or errors.
Must be called while the target is stopped.

memberdef.references: juce::Array< typename ElementType, typename TypeOfCriticalSectionToUse, int minimumAllocatedSize >::add

briefdescription.para: Evaluate a C++ expression in the context of a specific stack frame.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the debug scope to frameIndex, then executes "?? <expression>" via IDebugControl4::Execute with captured output. The raw output is passed through debug::formatSymbolValue before being returned.

parameterdescription.para: C++ expression string to evaluate (e.g. "myVar->field").
Zero-based stack frame index for symbol resolution context.

simplesect.para: Formatted result string, or an error description if evaluation fails.
Must be called while the target is stopped. Complex expressions may cause the engine to execute target code (function calls in expression).

memberdef.name: getThreads

briefdescription.para: Enumerate all threads in the target process.

detaileddescription.para: Uses IDebugSystemObjects::GetNumberThreads and GetThreadIdsByIndex to list all threads, resolving each to its OS thread ID.

Each element in the returned array is a DynamicObject with fields:
id (int) — OS thread ID (system TID, not dbgeng internal index)
name (String) — always empty (thread naming not implemented)

simplesect.para: Array of thread objects. Empty if enumeration fails.
Must be called while the target is stopped.

memberdef.references: juce::Array< typename ElementType, typename TypeOfCriticalSectionToUse, int minimumAllocatedSize >::add

briefdescription.para: Return the OS thread ID of the thread that triggered the last debug event.

detaileddescription.para: Calls IDebugSystemObjects::GetCurrentThreadSystemId. Valid only immediately after a WaitForEvent call returns an event (i.e., while stopped).

simplesect.para: OS system thread ID, or 0 if the query fails.

briefdescription.para: Set the current debug context to the thread with the given OS thread ID.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up the dbgeng internal thread index for systemId and calls IDebugSystemObjects::SetCurrentThreadId. All subsequent symbol queries (getLocals, getStackTrace, evaluateExpression) operate on this thread's context.

parameterdescription.para: OS system thread ID to make current.

simplesect.para: Must be called while the target is stopped. Invalid systemId is silently ignored.

briefdescription.para: Invalidate the cached symbol group so the next getLocals call rebuilds it.

detaileddescription.para: The symbol group cache is keyed on frame index. After a stop event the program counter changes, so the cached group is stale and must be discarded. Call this at the start of every stopped event before any variable queries.

briefdescription.para: Refresh cachedFrameVariables for the given frame if stale.

detaileddescription.para: Mirrors Windows getOrCreateSymbolGroup — keyed on frame index; regenerates the SBValueList when the cached index does not match. Callers may rely on cachedFrameVariables being valid for frameIndex after this returns.

parameterdescription.para: Zero-based stack frame index (0 = innermost).

briefdescription.para: Build a DAP variable object from an SBValue.

detaileddescription.para: Constructs a juce::var wrapping a DynamicObject with the schema: name, value, type, hasChildren, symbolIndex. Null-safe on every const char* return from SBValue. Used by getLocals and getVariableChildren to share a single source of truth for the variable schema.

parameterdescription.para: The SBValue to format.
Index to embed as the DAP symbolIndex field.

simplesect.para: juce::var holding the DynamicObject.

briefdescription.para: COM wrapper around the dbgeng debug engine interfaces.

detaileddescription.para: Session owns and manages the lifetime of all IDebug* COM interfaces acquired from dbgeng.dll. It provides a high-level API used by Whatdbg and BreakpointManager to drive a debug session: launching/attaching processes, polling for events, setting breakpoints, inspecting symbols, and stepping.

Ownership:
Owns the Loader that loaded dbgeng.dll.
Owns OutputCallbacks and EventCallbacks registered with IDebugClient5.
Owns all COM interface ComPtrs; releases them in ~Session.

simplesect.para: All methods must be called on the main thread. On Windows, COM is initialized in multithreaded mode by initialize(). Calling any method before initialize() succeeds will assert or produce undefined behavior.
